# Lab 28.5: Cost & Performance Audit

## What We Are Going to Do
Audit your course project like a real platform team: find the most expensive work, apply recommendations, choose the right pricing model, and write a one-page action plan.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Find the top cost drivers (Labs 20.2–20.3).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT user_email, statement_type,
  ROUND(SUM(total_bytes_billed) / POW(1024, 4), 3) AS tib_billed,
  ROUND(SUM(total_slot_ms) / 1000 / 3600, 2) AS slot_hours,
  COUNT(*) AS jobs
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.JOBS_BY_PROJECT
WHERE creation_time &gt; TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND statement_type != 'SCRIPT'
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY tib_billed DESC LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Find the heaviest tables in storage (Lab 2.9).**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT table_schema, table_name,
  ROUND(total_logical_bytes / POW(1024, 3), 2) AS logical_gib,
  ROUND(total_physical_bytes / POW(1024, 3), 2) AS physical_gib
FROM `region-us`.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLE_STORAGE
ORDER BY total_logical_bytes DESC LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Check Recommendations (Module 24)** and **Performance insights (Lab 6.10)** on the top 3 queries. Apply at least one partitioning, clustering or materialized view change and measure the saving.

4. **[SQL] Pricing decision (Lab 21.1).** Re-run the on-demand vs editions comparison with your full course history.

6. **Write the action plan.** One page with: top 3 cost drivers, changes made and savings, recommended pricing model, guardrails (quotas, max bytes billed, labels, alerts), and a review date.
